text:
sara_cs: Quick sync — just off a 45m onboarding with ClearStream. Their account health is OK but they called out 3 concrete pain points and 2 feature asks that are driving renewal sentiment. Capturing here so we can triage and get enablement docs ready.

mike_pm: thanks sara. can you paste the asks? prioritization will depend on impact + engineering ops cost.

sara_cs: sure — pasted raw notes below (cleaned):
- Ask A: per-route cost visibility in Console for multi-tenant usage (they want breakdown by route + model). renewal risk = medium.
- Ask B: automatic evaluation webhooks when we push model rollouts; they want to run internal QA before switching default. renewal risk = high.
- Ask C: better onboarding checklist for Dedicated customers (networking templates + KMS examples). renewal risk = low.
- Pain 1: unclear token-explanation in billing emails — finance team confused about embeddings vs tokens.
- Pain 2: customer experiencing spikes in tail latency when batch sizes vary suddenly.

ana_enable: these are great. i can draft a one-pager for Ask C and the onboarding checklist by EOD Fri. will need a contact for sample network config from infra.

devon_prod: Ask B sounds particularly high risk — we should offer a canary + webhook prototype. sam, can infra surface a short-term signal forwarding endpoint for them?

sam_engineering: possible. we can spin up an internal webhook relay for testing. estimate 2-3 days to build safe demo (auth, replay).

mike_pm: ok. proposed next steps: 1) create tickets for A/B/C with labels (renewal-risk, onboarding, billing-ux) 2) ana to draft enablement for C 3) sam to prototype webhook relay for B 4) sara to collect finance example screenshots for Pain 1. i'll prioritize B as P0, A as P1, C as P2.

sara_cs: adding screenshots in thread now — attaching via link: https://files.redwood/example/clearstream-billing-screens.png

redwood-bot: Created Jira issues RW-4521 (Ask B - rollout webhooks), RW-4522 (Ask A - per-route cost), RW-4523 (Ask C - onboarding checklist). :white_check_mark:

ana_enable: drafting checklist outline here: 
```
- network CIDR examples for Dedicated
- KMS key rotation snippet (AWS/GCP)
- sample security group rules + troubleshooting tips
- contact list: support + solutions engineer
```

mike_pm: looks good. sara — can you assign RW-4521 to sam and RW-4523 to ana? i'll take RW-4522 and scope cost db changes.

sara_cs: assigned RW-4521 -> sam_engineering, RW-4523 -> ana_enable. Also flagged RW-4521 as "customer-blocking" on the renewal tracker.

devon_prod: suggestion — for Ask A, could we deliver a temporary CSV export from billing as a stopgap while we build Console UI? faster win.

sam_engineering: yep we can add CSV export in ~4 days. low-risk.

mike_pm: agreed. add 'csv-export' task under RW-4522 as a quick deliverable.

sara_cs: final note — customer explicitly said: "if we don't get webhooks before next renewal call in 6 weeks, we'll escalate." tagging renewal team. :warning:

mike_pm: thanks — i'll loop in renewal manager and flag the timeline in the roadmap. good work everyone. :thumbsup:

sara_cs: thanks team — will post a 1-pager summary to the renewal channel and share status updates in this thread.
